Sandeep Patil Appointed Mumbai Team Mentor

Former Indian cricketer Sandeep Patil has been appointed as the team mentor for Mumbai. This appointment is for the 2026-27 season. Patil is known for his aggressive strokeplay and was part of India's 1983 World Cup-winning team.
